title: Fractal Analysis of Seismicity and Fault Network Geometry: R and Python Workflows (Marmara / NAFZ)
description: Reproducible R and Python workflow for quantifying the scale invariance of an earthquake catalogue: box-counting dimension (D0) and correlation dimension (D2) of the epicentre distribution, box-counting dimension of the fault-trace network, and the maximum-likelihood Gutenberg-Richter b-value, with magnitude-of-completeness selection and Gardner-Knopoff declustering. Demonstrated on the Marmara region of the North Anatolian Fault Zone. Supplementary code for the paper submitted to Contributions to Geophysics and Geodesy.
